claims: By December 2026, the U.S. Selective Service System will implement automatic draft registration for eligible men aged 18 to 26.
The U.S. Selective Service System will use federal data sources to replace manual sign-ups.
The change does not indicate an active draft or wartime conscription.
Active draft or wartime conscription has not occurred since 1973.
The Selective Service System will register men automatically via databases.
The automatic registration removes the requirement for self-registration.
Almost all male U.S. citizens aged 18–25 are required to be in the system.
Almost all male immigrants aged 18–25 including undocumented are required to be in the system.
There is currently no active military draft.
Sources say this does not mean a draft is imminent.
If a draft were authorized by Congress and the President, a lottery would be held.
Those whose 20th birthday falls in the year of the draft would be called first.
The order of call is followed by ages 21–25, then 19, then 18.
Men on active duty are exempt.
Women are not currently included in the draft
